text:
Maya (SupplyOps): FYI vendor ZenShip emailed — H100 shipment to FRA is slipping 3 weeks. They propose splitting our 40-unit allocation across 2 AWBs and applying a €1,200 cross-dock surcharge if we ask to consolidate. Need quick call: accept split or push for consolidation and longer delay?

Omar (Procurement): ouch. 3 weeks kills our Dedicated rollouts. Can we get price credit if we accept split? ask for surcharge waiver?

Jorge (Logistics): splitting is OK operationally but doubles customs entries and increases handling risk. If we accept split, we should insist on insurance coverage + photos on handover.

FreightBot: Forwarded vendor note: "ETA bump due to vendor factory queue. Option A: split AWBs (ETA +0 days), Option B: consolidated AWB (ETA +21 days), surcharge applies only to consolidation request." Attached: AWB draft IDs: TBD.

Lin (Infra): From infra side, latency to customers in EU is already degraded if we miss this batch. We should accept split if it reduces lead time. Are there temporary pools we can borrow from region?

Priya (EngOps): We have 8 warm spares in AMS pool. Could bridge some capacity for first 2 weeks if we stagger provisioning. But need serials + ETA to plan canary.

Omar (Procurement): I'll try to negotiate: request surcharge waiver in exchange for faster release and commitment to next tranche. Also push for consolidated paperwork (one invoice) even if two AWBs.

Maya (SupplyOps): Good. Also vendor mentioned ~4 DOA tolerance on arrivals historically. Jorge — RMA flow if DOA > 2? We need to avoid stuck units in depot.

Jorge (Logistics): Standard: depot inspects within 24h, photos + manifest -> vendor RMA within 72h. If they split AWBs, ensure single consolidated manifest for serial reconciliation or we'll have duplicate claims. Ask vendor to accept single RMA channel and one credit note.

FreightBot: Vendor excerpt: "We can accept consolidated claims if provided consolidated manifest (CSV of serials) within 48h of arrival. Insurance: full transit coverage available at vendor's cost if surcharge waived."

Lin (Infra): That insurance offer is a must. If vendor covers transit insurance, we mitigate split risk. Also request NVMe firmware parity check on receipt — seen 2 mismatches last quarter.

Priya (EngOps): Hold on firmware — if they arrive with mismatched firmware we need replacement path; that becomes RMA + imaging delay. Add a preflight test step at depot (power-on + firmware check) in SLA.

Omar (Procurement): Action: I'll ask for (1) surcharge waiver, (2) vendor-paid transit insurance, (3) single consolidated invoice + manifest even if 2 AWBs, (4) explicit RMA acceptance process with 48h manifest window. Give me till EOD to close.

Maya (SupplyOps): If vendor refuses surcharge waiver then what's threshold? pay if it shortens by >10 days?

Jorge (Logistics): Pay only if net landed-date improvement is >14 days. Otherwise accept split + vendor insurance.

Priya (EngOps): I'll draft temporary canary plan using 8 warm spares and rotate in units as they arrive. Need arrival dates to slot canaries.

Omar (Procurement): Update: vendor called — they'll waive surcharge if we commit to a 6-month purchase cadence for 2x the current volume. Not happening. Counter: waive surcharge for this shipment if we accept two AWBs and sign a one-time expedited handling fee credit on next order.

Maya (SupplyOps): Not ideal. I recommend we accept split with vendor-paid insurance + consolidated manifest + preflight depot test. Reject long-term purchase strings.

Jorge (Logistics): Agreed. I'll prepare depot checklist: photos, serial CSV, firmware version, power-on log snippet, and RMA ticket template.

Priya (EngOps): Send me the CSV when available; I'll map serials to pool assignments.

FreightBot: Noted. Next steps logged: Procurement to confirm terms (Omar), Logistics to publish depot checklist (Jorge), EngOps to prepare canary schedule (Priya).

Maya (SupplyOps): OK decision: accept split AWBs to keep ETA earlier, require vendor-paid transit insurance, consolidated manifest/invoice, preflight depot test + single RMA channel. Omar pls confirm with vendor and paste final vendor email here so ops can act. :thumbsup:
